test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:

"Something that is no longer in use."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Obsolete**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Obsolete"** means something that is no longer in use or has become outdated due to advancements in technology or changes in society. (प्राचीन या अप्रचलित)
 
 
• **Example:** The typewriter is now considered an obsolete device in the era of computers and laptops.
 

 
• **"Obsolete"** can also refer to practices or customs that are no longer relevant or followed in modern times.
 
 
• **Example:** Many old traditions have become obsolete in the modern world.
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Obsolete**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Antique** (प्राचीन): Refers to an object that is old and valuable, often a collectible item from the past.
 
 
• **Example:** The museum displayed an antique clock from the 18th century.
 
 

 
• **Contemporary** (समकालीन): Something that belongs to the same period or is modern and current.
 
 
• **Example:** The artist's contemporary paintings reflect current social issues.
 
 

 
• **Inevitable** (अपरिहार्य): Refers to something that is certain to happen and cannot be avoided.
 
 
• **Example:** Change is inevitable in every aspect of life.
